summary: Daily aggregation for Keeping Up with Silicon Valley (induscore.site/sv): Claude Code collects startup/funding/launch/VC stories from ~23 sources, curates them, persists them to the VM database through the site's ingest API and verifies they are live. Say /aggregate-silicon-valley [YYYY-MM-DD].
setup: One-time: get your own ingest token into ~/.config/keeping-up-sv/ingest.env (the command is in SKILL.md, 'One-time setup'), then run `python3 -I ~/.claude/skills/aggregate-silicon-valley/scripts/ingest.py --check`.
